license_required.quote: No person may provide, offer to provide, or attempt to provide medical nutrition therapy, whether for remuneration, or hold himself or herself out as a licensed dietitian nutritionist or as a qualified provider of nutrition care services, including medical nutrition therapy, unless the person is licensed in accordance with this Act.

issuing_authority.value: Department of Financial and Professional Regulation
issuing_authority.quote: "Department" means the Department of Financial and Professional Regulation.

name.value: Department of Financial and Professional Regulation
name.quote: "Department" means the Department of Financial and Professional Regulation.

type.quote: The Department shall exercise the powers and duties prescribed by the Civil Administrative Code of Illinois for the administration of licensing acts

degree_required.value: baccalaureate or post-baccalaureate degree with a major course of study in human nutrition, foods and nutrition, dietetics, or equivalent
degree_required.quote: possesses a baccalaureate degree or post baccalaureate degree with a major course of study in human nutrition, foods and nutrition, dietetics, food systems management, nutrition education, nutrition, nutrition science, clinical nutrition, applied clinical nutrition, nutrition counseling, nutrition and functional medicine, nutritional biochemistry, nutrition and integrative health, or an equivalent major course of study

accrediting_body.value: Council for Higher Education Accreditation and the United States Department of Education
accrediting_body.quote: from a school or program accredited at the time of graduation from the appropriate regional accrediting agency recognized by the Council for Higher Education Accreditation and the United States Department of Education

required.quote: has completed a dietetic internship or documented, supervised practice experience in dietetics and nutrition services of not less than 900 hours under the supervision of a qualified supervisor.

duration.quote: supervised practice experience in dietetics and nutrition services of not less than 900 hours

kind.value: dietetic internship or documented, supervised practice experience
kind.quote: has completed a dietetic internship or documented, supervised practice experience in dietetics and nutrition services

exams.name: Department-authorized examination (may include American Clinical Board of Nutrition, Certification Board of Nutrition Specialists, and Commission on Dietetic Registration exams)
exams.notes: Waiver available for current CNS, DACBN, or RD credential holders. The Department shall establish by rule a waiver of the examination requirement for such applicants.
exams.jurisdiction: national (ABCN, CBNS, CDR) or other Department-approved
exams.quote: has successfully completed an examination authorized by the Department which may be or may include examinations given by each of the American Clinical Board of Nutrition, the Certification Board of Nutrition Specialists, and the Commission on Dietetic Registration, or another examination approved by the Department.

required.quote: As a condition for renewal of a license, the licensee shall be required to complete continuing education in dietetics or nutrition services in accordance with rules established by the Department.

available.quote: The Department may, in its discretion, license as a dietitian nutritionist, without examination, on payment of required fee, an applicant who is a dietitian, dietitian nutritionist, or nutritionist licensed or certified under the laws of another state, territory, or country, if the Department determines that the requirements for licensure in the state, territory, or country in which the applicant was licensed were, at the date of his or her licensure, substantially equal to the requirements of this Act.

requirements.value: Applicant must be licensed or certified in another state, territory, or country with substantially equal requirements; no examination required; payment of required fee.
requirements.quote: license as a dietitian nutritionist, without examination, on payment of required fee, an applicant who is a dietitian, dietitian nutritionist, or nutritionist licensed or certified under the laws of another state, territory, or country, if the Department determines that the requirements for licensure in the state, territory, or country in which the applicant was licensed were, at the date of his or her licensure, substantially equal to the requirements of this Act.

exists.quote: The Secretary shall appoint a Dietitian Nutritionist Practice Board as follows: 7 individuals who shall be appointed by and shall serve in an advisory capacity to the Secretary.

name.quote: The Secretary shall appoint a Dietitian Nutritionist Practice Board

authority.value: advisory capacity to the Secretary; Secretary shall consider the recommendation of the Board on questions of standards of professional conduct, discipline, and qualifications of candidates or licensees
authority.quote: 7 individuals who shall be appointed by and shall serve in an advisory capacity to the Secretary. ... The Secretary shall consider the recommendation of the Board on questions of standards of professional conduct, discipline, and qualifications of candidates or licensees under this Act.

national_certification.quote: examinations given by each of the American Clinical Board of Nutrition, the Certification Board of Nutrition Specialists, and the Commission on Dietetic Registration

national_association.quote: "Commission on Dietetic Registration" means the credentialing agency for the Academy of Nutrition and Dietetics.

is_mandatory.quote: No person may provide, offer to provide, or attempt to provide medical nutrition therapy, whether for remuneration, or hold himself or herself out as a licensed dietitian nutritionist or as a qualified provider of nutrition care services, including medical nutrition therapy, unless the person is licensed in accordance with this Act.

title_protection.quote: Only a person who is issued a license as a dietitian nutritionist under this Act may use the words "licensed dietitian nutritionist", "dietitian nutritionist", or "dietitian" or the letters "L.D.N." or hold oneself out as qualified or licensed to practice under this Act in connection with his or her name.

scope_protection.quote: No person may provide, offer to provide, or attempt to provide medical nutrition therapy, whether for remuneration, or hold himself or herself out as a licensed dietitian nutritionist or as a qualified provider of nutrition care services, including medical nutrition therapy, unless the person is licensed in accordance with this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Material misstatement in furnishing information to the Department.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Material misstatement in furnishing information to the Department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violations of the Act or of rules adopted under it.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violations of this Act or of rules adopted under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or misdemeanor involving dishonesty or directly related to the profession.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction by plea of guilty or nolo contendere, finding of guilt, jury verdict, or entry of judgment or by sentencing of any crime, including, but not limited to, convictions, preceding sentences of supervision, conditional discharge, or first offender probation, under the laws of any jurisdiction of the United States (i) that is a felony or (ii) that is a misdemeanor, an essential element of which is dishonesty, or that is directly related to the practice of the profession.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or misrepresentation in applying for or renewing a license.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or any misrepresentation in applying for or procuring a license under this Act or in connection with applying for renewal of a license under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Professional incompetence or gross negligence.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Professional incompetence or gross negligence.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Malpractice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Malpractice.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Aiding or assisting another person in violating any provision of the Act or its rules.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Aiding or assisting another person in violating any provision of this Act or its rules.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failing to provide information within 60 days in response to a written request by the Department.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failing to provide information within 60 days in response to a written request made by the Department.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in dishonorable, unethical or unprofessional conduct likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in dishonorable, unethical or unprofessional conduct of a character likely to deceive, defraud, or harm the public.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of controlled substances, alcohol, or other substances resulting in inability to practice safely.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Habitual or excessive use or abuse of drugs defined in law as controlled substances, alcohol, or any other substance that results in the inability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Discipline by another state, territory, country, or governmental agency on substantially equivalent grounds.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Discipline by another state, the District of Columbia, territory, country, or governmental agency if at least one of the grounds for the discipline is the same or substantially equivalent to those set forth in this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Charging for professional services not rendered, including filing false statements for collection of fees.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Charging for professional services not rendered, including filing false statements for the collection of fees for which services are not rendered.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating the terms of probation after license was placed on probationary status.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A finding by the Department that the licensee, after having his or her license placed on probationary status, has violated the terms of probation.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully making or filing false records or reports in practice.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully making or filing false records or reports in his or her practice, including, but not limited to, false records filed with State agencies or departments.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Allowing one's license to be used by an unlicensed person.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Allowing one's license under this Act to be used by an unlicensed person in violation of this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Practicing under a false or assumed name.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Practicing under a false or, except as provided by law, an assumed name.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Gross and willful overcharging for professional services.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Gross and willful overcharging for professional services.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Willfully failing to report an instance of suspected child abuse or neglect.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Willfully failing to report an instance of suspected child abuse or neglect as required by the Abused and Neglected Child Reporting Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cheating on or attempting to subvert a licensing examination.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cheating on or attempting to subvert a licensing examination administered under this Act.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Mental illness or disability that results in inability to practice with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Mental illness or disability that results in the inability to practice under this Act with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Physical illness, including deterioration through aging or loss of motor skill, resulting in inability to practice safely.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Physical illness, including, but not limited to, deterioration through the aging process or loss of motor skill that results in a licensee's inability to practice under this Act with reasonable judgment, skill, or safety.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Advising an individual to discontinue, reduce, increase, or otherwise alter intake of a drug prescribed by a physician or prescriber.
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Advising an individual to discontinue, reduce, increase, or otherwise alter the intake of a drug prescribed by a physician licensed to practice medicine in all its branches or by a prescriber as defined in Section 102 of the Illinois Controlled Substances Act.

definition_quote.value: the integration, application, and communication of practice principles derived from the sciences of food, nutrition, social, business, and basic sciences to achieve and maintain the optimal nutrition status of individuals and groups
definition_quote.quote: "Dietetics" means the integration, application, and communication of practice principles derived from the sciences of food, nutrition, social, business, and basic sciences to achieve and maintain the optimal nutrition status of individuals and groups.

value: medical nutrition therapy
nutrition assessment
nutrition counseling
nutrition intervention
nutrition monitoring and evaluation
ordering nutrition-related laboratory tests
recommending and ordering enteral and parenteral nutrition
developing and managing food service operations
ordering oral and parenteral therapeutic diets
methods_authorized.quote: "Nutrition care services" means any part of the following services provided within a systematic process: (1) assessing and evaluating the nutritional needs of individuals and groups ... (2) ordering nutrition-related laboratory tests ... (3) establishing priorities, goals, and objectives ... (4) providing nutrition counseling ... (5) developing, implementing, and managing nutrition care systems and food service operations; (6) evaluating, making changes in, and maintaining appropriate standards of quality in food and nutrition services; and (7) recommending, ordering, and providing therapeutic diets.

value: licensed dietitian nutritionist
license_type_structure.quote: "Licensed dietitian nutritionist" means a person licensed under this Act to practice dietetics and nutrition, including the provision of medical nutrition therapy

dietetic_technician_recognized.quote: The provision of nutrition care services by a nutrition and dietetic technician or a graduate of a 2 year associate program or a 4 year baccalaureate program from a school or program accredited ... with a major course of study in human nutrition, food and nutrition or its equivalent, as authorized by the Department, who is directly supervised by an individual licensed under this Act.

rd_credential_accepted_in_lieu_of_state_.quote: The Department shall establish by rule a waiver of the examination requirement to applicants who, at the time of application, are acknowledged to be certified nutrition specialists by the Certification Board of Nutrition Specialists, diplomates of the American Clinical Board of Nutrition, or registered dietitians by the Commission on Dietetic Registration and who are in compliance with other qualifications as included in the Act.

value: Certified Nutrition Specialist (CNS) by the Board for Certification of Nutrition Specialists
Diplomate of the American Clinical Board of Nutrition (DACBN)
alternative_credential_pathways.quote: The Department shall establish by rule a waiver of the examination requirement to applicants who, at the time of application, are acknowledged to be certified nutrition specialists by the Certification Board of Nutrition Specialists, diplomates of the American Clinical Board of Nutrition, or registered dietitians by the Commission on Dietetic Registration

medical_nutrition_therapy_authorized.quote: The practice of dietetics and nutrition, including the provision of medical nutrition therapy, in the State of Illinois is hereby declared to affect the public health, safety, and welfare and to be subject to regulation and control in the public interest.

enteral_parenteral_nutrition_authorized.quote: interpreting anthropometric, biochemical, clinical, and dietary data in acute and chronic disease states and recommending and ordering nutrient needs based on the dietary data, including, but not limited to, enteral and parenteral nutrition

diet_order_writing_authority.quote: A licensed dietitian nutritionist may order patient or resident diets, including therapeutic diets

lab_test_ordering_authority.quote: ordering nutrition-related laboratory tests in accordance with State law to check and track nutrition status and monitor effectiveness of nutrition interventions, dietary plans, and orders

diagnosis_treatment_prohibition.quote: Activities of a licensed dietitian nutritionist do not include performing medical diagnosis of human ailments or conditions of an individual.

telehealth_practice_authorized.quote: Telehealth or telepractice is not prohibited under this Act provided that the provision of telehealth or telepractice services is appropriate for the client and the level of care provided meets the required level of care for that client.

value: Any person licensed in this State under any other Act (within their licensed scope)
Persons employed by the United States or State government in official duties
Cooperative extension home economists
Students in supervised course of study
Individuals fulfilling post-degree supervised practice experience
Health food store operators or employees providing verbal nutrition information
Educators employed by nonprofit organizations, government agencies, or accredited institutions
Persons providing medical weight control services for prediabetes or obesity under approved programs
Persons engaged in education and research with masters or doctorate in nutrition
Nutrition and dietetic technicians directly supervised by a licensed dietitian nutritionist
Employees of nursing facilities relying solely on spiritual means/prayer
Dietary technical support persons working in hospital or regulated facility settings supervised by a licensed dietitian nutritionist
Persons providing nutrition care services without remuneration to family members
Out-of-state practitioners assisting in public health emergencies (up to 6 months)
exempt_professions_list.quote: This Act does not prohibit or restrict: (a) Any person licensed in this State under any other Act from engaging in the practice for which he or she is licensed ... (b) Any person from providing medical nutrition therapy if that person is employed by the United States or State government ... (c) The distribution of general nonmedical nutrition information by a person employed as a cooperative extension home economist

federal_employee_exemption.quote: Any person from providing medical nutrition therapy if that person is employed by the United States or State government or any of its bureaus, divisions, departments, or agencies while in the discharge of the employee's official duties.

weight_control_program_exemption.quote: An individual providing medical weight control services for individuals with prediabetes or obesity if: (1) under a program of instruction approved in writing by, consultation is available from, and no program change can be initiated without prior approval by one of the following: a dietitian nutritionist licensed in this State; or a State-licensed health care professional

food_supplement_sales_exemption.quote: A person, including a licensed acupuncturist, from: (1) providing verbal nutrition information as an operator or employee of a health food store or business that sells health products, including dietary supplements, food, herbs, or food materials; or (2) disseminating written general nonmedical nutrition information in connection with the marketing and distribution of those products

nonresident_temporary_practice_allowed.quote: The practice of dietetics and nutrition for a period not exceeding 6 months by a person who is in the State on a temporary basis to assist in a case of public health emergency and who meets the qualifications for a licensed dietitian nutritionist as set forth in Section 45 and is licensed in another state as a provider of medical nutrition therapy.

nutrition_assessment_includes_biochemica.quote: "Nutrition assessment" means the systematic process of obtaining, verifying, and interpreting biochemical, anthropometric, physical, nutrigenomic, and dietary data

hospital_order_authority_requires_policy.quote: Notification to the patient's physician and appropriate record retention, or pursuant to the protocols, policies, or procedures of a health care facility, as defined in the Illinois Health Facilities Planning Act, in which the services are provided.

inactive_license_status_available.quote: Any person who notifies the Department in writing on forms or electronically as prescribed by the Department may elect to place his or her license on an inactive status
